from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper: its title and the titles of other provided papers it references."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of this paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers that are referenced in this paper's bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated data extracted from a single document."""
    papers: list[Paper]
